resources.string: There is no Dastyar server in the middle. Your key, chats, and files stay on the device. You choose a provider, and that provider is the one that sees a message.

Sending a text, placing a call, deleting a file, or tapping another app waits for you. Permissions come later, one at a time. On Android 13 and later, a sideloaded install may also need Allow restricted settings.
On Android 12 and later, dynamic colors follow the wallpaper. Brand keeps the teal and clay palette. Older phones stay on brand.
Add a clock, SMS, or notification trigger below. It stays off until you turn it on.
Confirmed actions will show the time, the tool, and a short redacted result.
Facts you or the model save stay on this phone. There is no vector index in this version.
You turn each item on. Dastyar never grants them silently, and it does not ask for the whole list on first launch. Skip anything you do not need.
On Android 13 and later, an install from outside the store cannot receive SMS, call log, accessibility, or notification access until you allow restricted settings.
Read and send SMS. Each send still asks you. Android 13+ may also need Allow restricted settings.
Place a call only after you confirm, and read the call log if you allow it.
Search contacts and save a number you asked for.

Accessibility reads the screen and can tap other apps after a disclosure and a confirmation. Overlay is the status bubble. Seeing every installed app uses package visibility, which has no extra dialog.
Dastyar\'s own notification shows background work. Notification access reads alerts you can already see. Nothing is auto-replied.
A folder you pick is enough for files. All-files access is optional and is not part of Fix everything. Photos can use the system picker without a library grant.
Fine or coarse location first. Background location is a second step, and only if a routine needs it.
The camera and microphone are used only when you take a photo, record, or dictate.
Exact alarms, battery, usage access, system settings, Do Not Disturb, calendar, and optional Shizuku. Shizuku is not a substitute for the grants above.
Skip for now and open chat
Chats, keys, and files stay on this phone. A message leaves the device only when you send it to the provider you chose, or when you turn on a connector. Dastyar has no server in the middle.

Open this app\'s Permissions screen and turn a row off in Android settings, or open the system page from Fix. You can also revoke from Android Settings → Apps → Dastyar, or uninstall the app. Uninstall deletes the on-device vault with the app.
Sending a message, email, or call, and deleting or paying, still ask you even when confirmation is set to Auto. An unattended routine is off unless you turn that one routine on.
Permission diagnostics do not include message text, keys, or tokens.
